name: SamiGPT (AI SOC Agent)
description: SOC analyst agent platform that links case management, SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence so an LLM can investigate alerts.
whatItDoes: Gives security operations teams an assistant that can pull alerts, query logs, look up indicators and update cases during triage. It is designed to plug into the tools a SOC already runs.
howItWorks: Integrations for case management, SIEM such as Elastic, endpoint detection and threat intelligence are exposed as tools on an MCP server. A setup wizard configures the connections, and chat front ends such as Open WebUI drive the investigations.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Onboarding stack is started with Docker Compose

requirements.name: Security tooling
requirements.description: SIEM, EDR, case management and intel services to connect

models: Depends on the connected MCP client or chat front end
